description: data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data) is an open data portal listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics, published or maintained by U.S. Bureau of Transportation Statistics. The Bureau of Transportation Statistics portal lists datasets on U.S. transportation activity: airline on-time performance, border crossings, freight, transit ridership, fatalities and related statistics, with API and download options for each. Coverage: United States. The catalogue lists 153 datasets, each with its own page, description and export options. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network and hazard studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
